decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered 7742/02, 7742/03, 7742/04, 7742/05, 7742/06 Received 27/10/2010 and 7742/01A Received 10/11/2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The premises shall be used for an education and training centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for an education and training centre shall not be carried on outside the following times: Monday-Friday 0900-2100 and Saturdays 0900-2100.
description: Continued use of the first and second floors of the building for educational (D1) purposes.
